title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
  
  
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
  
  
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
  
  
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth

**Compensation**
The monthly compensation range for this role is:
  
  
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
  
  
Final compensation will depend on experience, product-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

A passionate, design-thinking-first designer who starts with the problem, not the pixels. You understand people, you sweat the details, and you believe great design is the difference between a product people tolerate and one they love. You want a career in design, not just an internship.

* Work that ships — real products, real users, real portfolio material.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:

Leading retail banking projects through to delivery within Backbase’s design team to become the preferred consumer banking app. A diplomat between the Design team and other stakeholders, advocating for customers, championing human-centric approaches and design thinking.

Fintech is one of the fastest growing markets at present, with an enormous need for talented Product Designers to improve user experiences for customers of banks. Our Retail Banking Product team is at the centre of a global transformation, creating journeys that impact more than 70 million people on a daily basis.
  
  
You’ll be a critical member of the team, working directly with the Product and Developer Leads bringing to the table impressive design skills, effective communication and a proven ability to innovate.
  
  
In addition to easily traversing the scale between minutia and big-picture, you will be intimate with the end-to-end experience of design objects and how those objects translate into business value.
  
  
Managing design projects from beginning to end, and ensuring design efforts meet both customers' needs and business goals will be a key part of your role. As a diplomat, you will have no qualms convincing stakeholders of the efficacy of design principles and the value it brings to the business.

**How about you?**

* You have 5-8 years’ experience in Product Design
* You are proficient in design tools, specifically Figma
* You have extensive experience working in Agile teams
* You are a disruptor and innovator
* You’re equally talented in analytics and creativity
* You’re capable of looking at the big picture and diving into details

* You’re an excellent communicator, confident writer, and speaker (English essential)

Join our team and be a part of a certified Great Place to Work! We’re proud to have achieved this recognition in India, Australia, Singapore, and Vietnam. As a company, we’re committed to providing a positive and inclusive work environment where our employees can thrive. So, what are you waiting for? Come be a part of our culture and grow with us.

title: UX Designer
description:
**Job Description**
**UX Designer**
Summary/objective
  
  
isolved builds Human Capital Management software that millions of people use to get paid, manage time off, enroll in benefits, and run HR for their companies. The work touches essential parts of people's lives, so the experience needs to be clear, efficient, and trustworthy. You'll drive evidence-based product decisions for the isolved platform, working alongside engineers and product managers as the designer for the experiences you're assigned. You plan the research, shape the direction, and carry the work from problem framing through to what ships, using design thinking methods to ground decisions in how people actually behave rather than how we assume they do.The isolved platform is broad and interconnected. The designers who do well here can design a feature and also see how it ripples through the rest of the product: what it touches, what it changes, and what has to stay consistent.
  
  
Core Job Duties
  
  

* End-to-end experience design: discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, and handoff
* Choose the right research method for the question at hand, run it, and turn raw findings into insights the team can act on. Synthesis and storytelling matter as much as the research itself
* Bring product and engineering into the research as it happens so decisions are shared, not pitched after the fact
* Design with the isolved design system and build on it, contributing new components and patterns when your work exposes a gap
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders, with clear goals and tangible outcomes
* Present work to the design team and stakeholders, give and take critique well, and iterate quickly
* Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow: research planning, synthesis, competitive analysis, exploration, and documentation
* Design for accessibility and for the range of devices and contexts our users work in

Job Complexity
  
  
Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands-on, go-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).
  
  
Interaction
  
  
Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise.
  
  
**Supervision**
Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree; 6 years and a master's degree; or equivalent experience.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Two to five years designing software products, ideally complex, data-heavy business applications
* A portfolio that shows how you think, not just what you shipped: the problem, the constraints, what you tried, and why the final answer won
* A clear research-to-design methodology. You can explain why you picked qualitative over quantitative (or the reverse) on a real project, and how research showed up across the whole process, not only in discovery
* Experience working within an established design system and contributing back to it, and the judgment to know when to extend it versus follow it
* A habit of looking for the root problem. The request you receive is often a symptom
* Comfort with the full UX toolkit: research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping
* Fluency with AI as a working tool. You already use it across your design process: planning and synthesizing research, exploring directions, prototyping, writing, and pressure-testing your own thinking. You can explain where it made your work better and where you overrode it
* Direct, concise communication with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders

**Nice To Have**

* Experience using AI to build or maintain design system assets, or designing AI-driven product experiences
* Enough working knowledge of front-end concepts to have a good conversation with an engineer about how something gets built
* Experience in HCM, payroll, benefits, or another regulated, workflow-heavy domain
* Experience modernizing a legacy product while it stays in production

**Physical Demands**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.
  
  
**Travel Required**
Yes, up to 15% domestic travel may be required.
  
  
**FLSA Classification**
Exempt
  
  
**Location**
Office/Hybrid/Remote
  
  
**Internal Job Title**
UX Designer
  
  
**About Isolved**
isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers - who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HR & payroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.
  
  
isolved is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and openminded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. Visit www.isolvedeebenefits.com for a comprehensive list of our employee total rewards offerings.

title: Instrumentation / Telecom Designer
description:
Job Summary:\*\*
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Instrumentation / Telecom Designer to join our team at Cyient, Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and implementation of instrumentation and telecommunication systems for various projects, ensuring adherence to industry standards, client specifications, and best practices.
  
  
Job Responsibilities:\*\*
  
  
\* Develop detailed design documents, including P&IDs, wiring diagrams, loop diagrams, instrument index, data sheets, and installation details for instrumentation systems.
  
\* Design and specify telecommunication systems, including fiber optic networks, industrial wireless solutions, voice communication systems, and network infrastructure.
  
\* Perform calculations and analyses for instrument sizing, control valve sizing, and communication link budgets.
  
\* Prepare material requisitions, technical specifications, and scope of work for instrumentation and telecom equipment procurement.
  
\* Collaborate with engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to ensure integrated and efficient system designs.
  
\* Conduct site surveys and gather necessary data for design development and problem-solving.
  
\* Review vendor drawings and technical proposals to ensure compliance with design requirements.
  
\* Support construction, commissioning, and startup activities related to instrumentation and telecom systems.
  
\* Identify and resolve design conflicts and technical issues in a timely manner.
  
\* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies.
  
  
Job Qualifications:\*\*
  
  
\* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
  
\* Minimum of 5 years of experience in instrumentation and/or telecommunications design, preferably in industrial or infrastructure projects.
  
\* Proficiency in relevant design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, SmartPlant Instrumentation (SPI), or equivalent.
  
\* Strong understanding of industry standards and codes (e.g., ISA, NEC, TIA/EIA).
  
\* Experience with various instrumentation types (e.g., pressure, temperature, flow, level transmitters, control valves).
  
\* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, Profibus, Foundation Fieldbus, Ethernet/IP).
  
\* Familiarity with network design principles and components (routers, switches, firewalls).
  
\* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
\* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  
\* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work effectively to meet deadlines.

title: Autocad Designer(Civil)
description:
**Company Description**
4K Sports Infra Private Limited is a leading sports infrastructure company that designs, builds, and maintains professional sports facilities across India. The company serves schools, colleges, sports academies, residential complexes, corporate campuses, and government bodies, converting empty grounds into high-quality playing arenas. With over 25 years of experience and a 99.99% customer retention rate, 4K Sports Infra is known for its quality work, transparent pricing, and reliable project execution. The company delivers turnkey solutions that include consultation, 3D design, certified materials, professional installation, and ongoing maintenance. Operating with a pan-India presence and international standards, 4K Sports Infra supports clients across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and other regions in India.
  
**Role Description**
The Autocad Designer (Civil) role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. This role involves preparing detailed civil and architectural drawings for sports infrastructure projects, including layouts for cricket grounds, football fields, tennis courts, athletic tracks, and multi-sport complexes. The Autocad Designer will work closely with project managers and engineers to develop 2D and 3D plans, ensure accurate construction drawings, and align designs with client requirements and site conditions. Daily responsibilities include refining design concepts, updating drawings based on feedback, coordinating with site teams for measurements and clarifications, and maintaining documentation for design revisions. The role also requires collaborating with internal stakeholders to support timely project execution and adherence to quality standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Architectural Drawings and Construction Drawings for civil and sports infrastructure projects.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Drawing and Space Planning to develop efficient layouts for sports facilities and supporting structures.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with project managers, engineers, site teams, and clients.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and related design software; knowledge of 3D modeling tools is an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* Experience in infrastructure or sports facility design, including site planning and detailing, is preferred.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications, site measurements, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Senior Printed Circuit Board Designer
description:
We are seeking a Senior PCB Design Engineer with 5 to 7 years of hardware layout experience to lead the development of our next-generation medical monitoring platforms. In this role, you will design clinical-grade 4 to 6-layer PCBs spanning both Rigid and Rigid-Flex architectures. Your work will power a versatile ecosystem that includes compact, battery-operated wearable devices as well as bedside consoles running on medical-grade AC-DC adapters. Leveraging Altium Designer and KiCad, you will bridge microvolt-level EEG signal acquisition with rigorous medical safety compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

•⁠ ⁠Multi-Layer Layout (Rigid & Flex): Execute advanced component placement and routing for 4–6 layer rigid, flexible, and rigid-flex configurations, optimizing for compact medical enclosures.

•⁠ ⁠Low-Noise Bio-Signal Layout: Implement expert layout strategies to capture low-amplitude EEG/ECG signals, isolating sensitive analog front-ends (AFEs) from digital noise and switching regulators.

•⁠ ⁠Dual Power Architecture Design: Design robust power distribution networks (PDN) capable of managing low-power battery operations alongside high-voltage mains charging via medical-grade AC-DC adapters.

•⁠ ⁠Medical Compliance & Isolation: Implement strict trace clearances, creepage distances, and protective grounding schemes to meet IEC 60601-1 patient isolation requirements (MOPP/MOOP).

•⁠ ⁠Tool Proficiency: Maintain native workflows across both Altium Designer and KiCad, including layout migration and component library management.

•⁠ ⁠DFx for Rigid-Flex: Apply specialized Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Assembly (DFA) rules for flexible circuits (e.g., bend radius constraints, teardrops, stiffener placements, and trace transitions).

•⁠ ⁠Documentation & Audit Readiness: Generate complete production packages (Gerbers, ODB++, IPC-2581, BOM) formatted to satisfy strict FDA/CE medical device history file (DHF) requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

•⁠ ⁠Experience: 5–7 years of professional PCB layout experience, with a core focus on 4–6 layer boards.

•⁠ ⁠Rigid-Flex Expertise: Proven track record of delivering production-ready flexible or rigid-flex PCB designs.

•⁠ ⁠Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Altium Designer and KiCad.

•⁠ ⁠Medical Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of IEC 60601-1 safety standards, ISO 13485 design controls, and low-noise/shielding techniques for bio-potentials.

•⁠ ⁠Power Management: Experience layout out battery management systems (BMS), charging circuits, and filtering for medical-grade AC-DC inputs.

•⁠ ⁠Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

•⁠ ⁠Experience modeling mechanical fitment and flex constraints using ECAD/MCAD co-design (STEP/IDX with SolidWorks or Fusion360).

•⁠ ⁠Background in high-density interconnect (HDI) layout or micro-via placement for miniature wearables.

•⁠ ⁠Active involvement in resolving engineering queries (EQs) with specialized flex-PCB fabrication houses.

title: Senior Product/Conversational Designer
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Teradata is seeking an AI-first Senior Product Designer with strong conversational design expertise to lead the creation of experiences that serve complex enterprise personas—from platform administrators to data leaders who need strategic visibility into consumption, governance, security, and business value realization across the enterprise platform.
* You’ll be developing enterprise-grade governance and observability workflows that not only surface system metrics but also connect them to business impact and confident action. This role is central to shaping how humans and AI collaborate across our enterprise-scale data platform, delivering intuitive, accessible experiences that make complex tasks simple and powerful.
* You’ll partner with product, design, information architecture, engineering, and AI stakeholders to craft experiences for enterprise leaders and decision-makers across regulated and high-stakes industries—where precision, trust, and compliance aren’t negotiable.
* You’ll design context-aware, human-centered experiences that span GUI, CLI, APIs, and conversational interfaces. Your work will ensure data practitioners can build and run AI/ML solutions with the right-sized compute resources while administrators monitor, observe, and act effortlessly—all within a unified AI-first experience strategy.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own product UX and language for core platform experiences, designing seamless handoff experiences between data practitioners, administrators, and platform decision makers—translating insights into actions and shaping moments that tie tasks to feature activation, resource expansion, and spend decisions.
* Design conversational and agentic AI experiences: create conversation flows, dialogue maps, and structured prompts for assistants and multimodal product experiences.
* Establish and evolve voice, tone, and persona guidelines to ensure consistent UX writing and conversational behavior across product surfaces (UI + assistant).
* Craft UX writing and microcopy across the product: labels, system messages, onboarding flows, help text, and error states—ensuring clarity, accessibility, and enterprise-ready terminology.
* Prototype in Figma and iterate rapidly using a mix of clickable UI prototypes and conversational artifacts (scripts, dialogue maps, prompt sets). Collaborate closely with PM and engineering, and be comfortable enough with code concepts to understand technical feasibility and implementation constraints.
* Contribute to prompt libraries, intent taxonomies, and multimodal conversational behaviors that scale across the platform and accelerate consistent delivery.
* Analyze and improve AI interactions: review analytics, transcripts, and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve conversation quality, task success, and accessibility; experiment, evaluate AI responses, and iterate based on data.
* Define UX observability metrics (task success, adoption, trust signals) and iterate based on data-informed insights, including AI and conversational quality signals.
* Shape onboarding experiences and best-practice guides that accelerate time to value and help enterprise users get value from Teradata quickly.
* Add to scalable quality systems with agentic skills and taxonomy insights that help teams move at velocity while upholding our quality bar.
* Collaborate across teams—product designers, content designers, conversational AI specialists, technical writers, engineers, researchers, and ML partners—participating in critiques and contributing to shared design guidelines and best practices.
* Mentor and inspire teams to do their best work in AI and humans-in-the-loop contexts, modeling AI fluency and creativity.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8+ years in product/UX design, with 1–3+ years focused on AI-driven and/or conversational experiences, ideally in enterprise-scale platforms.
* Strong design and prototyping fluency in Figma; you think in interactions and can express ideas through UI prototypes and conversation flows.
* Experience developing messaging and experiences for complex technical products and multiple personas (enterprise/B2B). You’re a strong systems thinker, with language as one of your primary lenses.
* Demonstrated conversational design craft: conversation mapping, structured prompts, UX writing/microcopy, and the ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, helpful interactions.
* Understanding of enterprise buying and usage journeys and the ability to craft experiences that work for end users, administrators, and customers simultaneously.
* Portfolio showing strategic thinking and clear language that moved key product or business metrics (e. g. , adoption, task success, time-to-value, trust).
* Track record of building from scratch and problem solving in ambiguity; you can rethink and redesign systems with proven impact on user and business outcomes.
* Empathy for users and an understanding of goals/jobs-to-be-done, with a curiosity for AI-powered experiences and a bias toward iteration and learning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing AI and with AI, including human-in-the-loop workflows and agentic interaction patterns.
* Experience working on SaaS, enterprise, or B2B products.
* Familiarity with conversational design tools and methods (e. g. , conversation mapping, prototyping tools such as Voiceflow/Botmock, plus Figma).
* History conducting user research and customer interviews to shape UX strategy, and using analytics/transcripts to iteratively improve AI interactions.

Why Join Us
  
  

* You’ll define the next generation of AI-powered experiences for one of the most advanced data platforms in the industry, creating a unified platform that empowers data practitioners to innovate faster and enterprise decision makers to unlock insights effortlessly. Your leadership will transform enterprise workflows into intelligent, adaptive experiences that scale globally.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Visual Communication & AI Creative Specialist
description:
⚠️ IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A SALARIED JOB OPENING - IT'S A PARTNERSHIP PROPOSAL

Founding Partner – Visual Communication, Graphic Design, Video & AI Creative

MIIGO Digital Marketing Division | Hyderabad / Hybrid / Remote as mutually agreed

MIIGO ONLINE LLP is exploring the formation of a dedicated Digital Marketing Division under a shared-responsibility and profit-sharing partnership model.

We are looking for an experienced creative professional who is interested not merely in joining as an employee, but in building, operating and growing the Visual Communication & Creative Production function as a long-term business partner.

Potential Earning Opportunity

Based on MIIGO's preliminary business projections, the tentative average earning potential over the first three years is estimated at approximately ₹18 LPA+, subject to business performance, revenue generation, agreed responsibilities and the final profit-sharing structure.

This figure is a business projection and not a guaranteed salary or fixed compensation.

Candidates interested in understanding the complete business and partnership model may share their CV and portfolio via WhatsApp:+91 93986 93085

About MIIGO

MIIGO ONLINE LLP develops advanced measurement, monitoring, data-logging, instrumentation and AI-enabled industrial solutions for industries including:

Pharmaceutical • Cleanrooms • HVAC • Calibration • Cold Chain • Food • Healthcare • Laboratories • Manufacturing • Industrial Automation • Engineering & B2B Technology

As MIIGO expands its product portfolio and international presence, we are developing a specialised MIIGO Digital Marketing Division capable of delivering professional B2B marketing, creative production and digital-growth services for MIIGO as well as external clients.

The Partnership Role

Senior Visual Communication & AI Creative Specialist – Partner

We are looking for someone who can convert complex technical products, engineering information and commercial concepts into visually outstanding, technically accurate and commercially effective communication.

This opportunity is not suitable for someone whose experience is limited primarily to routine Canva templates or social-media posts.

The partner should eventually be capable of managing the complete creative workflow:

Understand → Structure → Conceptualise → Design → Review → Correct → Validate → Deliver

Key Responsibilities1. Technical Graphic Design

Create professional visual communication including:

• Product catalogues and brochures

• Technical datasheets

• Product manuals and user guides

• Application notes

• Product comparison sheets

• Specification tables

• Technical infographics

• Feature illustrations

• Process and architecture diagrams

• Software/UI presentations

• Exhibition and trade-show graphics

• Distributor/OEM presentations

• Email and WhatsApp marketing creatives

• LinkedIn/social-media creatives

• Website graphics and banners

• Product-launch materials

• Training and corporate presentations

A critical requirement is the ability to present substantial technical information without making the design crowded, confusing or visually tiring.

2. Catalogue & Technical Documentation Design

Develop structured multi-page documents using:

• Strong information hierarchy

• Professional grid systems

• Consistent typography

• Master-page systems

• Section architecture

• Technical tables

• Charts and graphs

• Icons and illustrations

• Product photography

• Callouts and specifications

• Headers and footers

• Revision/version information

• Page numbering

• Cross-document visual consistency

The candidate must understand that a technical catalogue, user manual, marketing brochure, datasheet and social-media advertisement require different communication strategies.

3. Brand-System Management

Help build and maintain a scalable MIIGO visual system covering:

• Brand-guideline compliance

• Logo usage

• Typography

• Brand colours

• Reusable design templates

• Component libraries

• Icon systems

• Technical-table standards

• Product-image treatment

• Catalogue systems

• Social-media systems

The objective is simple:

Regardless of who creates a MIIGO communication asset, it should look unmistakably MIIGO.

4. Product Image & Visual Enhancement

Work with actual MIIGO product photographs and engineering visuals for:

• Professional image cleanup

• Background removal

• Retouching

• Perspective correction

• Lighting correction

• Shadows

• Application scenes

• Technical callouts

• Product-feature close-ups

• Website-ready imagery

• E-commerce graphics

• Exploded or technical visualisation where appropriate

Technical integrity is mandatory.

Product geometry, connectors, displays, labels, proportions and engineering attributes must never be altered inaccurately merely to improve visual appearance.

5. Video Production & Editing

Create professional:

• Product-introduction videos

• Product-feature videos

• Application videos

• Technical explainers

• Demonstration videos

• Software walkthroughs

• Installation videos

• Training videos

• LinkedIn videos and reels

• YouTube content

• Exhibition videos

• Distributor/OEM presentations

• Corporate films

The partner should be comfortable with:

Storyboarding • Scene sequencing • Professional editing • Motion graphics • Kinetic typography • Product callouts • Subtitles • Voice-over synchronisation • Music & SFX • Audio balancing • Colour correction/grading • Screen recordings • Logo animation • Multi-format exports

We value professional pacing and storytelling, not excessive dependence on generic transitions and ready-made templates.

6. AI-Assisted Creative Production

MIIGO actively uses AI to improve creative productivity.

Applications may include:

• Creative concept generation

• Storyboarding

• Background generation

• Image generation and enhancement

• Product-environment concepts

• AI video generation

• B-roll generation

• Image-to-video

• Generative fill

• Object removal

• Voice generation

• Avatar-based presentations

• Script development

• Motion concepts

• Visual variations

However, AI is a production accelerator—not a replacement for professional creative judgement.

The person must be capable of identifying and correcting AI-generated visual, technical, anatomical, branding and product-representation errors before publication.

Preferred Professional Tools Graphic Design / Publishing

Strong capability with several of:

Adobe Photoshop • Illustrator • InDesign • Lightroom • Affinity Designer • Affinity Photo • Affinity Publisher • Canva Pro

Adobe InDesign or Affinity Publisher experience is strongly preferred for technical catalogues and documentation.

Video / Motion

Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • Final Cut Pro • After Effects • CapCut Professional • Adobe Audition or equivalent professional tools

Motion-graphics capability will be an advantage.

MIIGO's Existing AI / Creative Stack

The partner may also work with tools including:

Canva Pro • InVideo • HeyGen • FlexClip • Phot.AI • ChatGPT • Claude • Gemini • Perplexity

We expect the partner to continuously evaluate better tools where they provide a genuine quality or productivity advantage.

Skills We Value

• Excellent typography

• Advanced page-layout capability

• Strong visual hierarchy

• Colour theory

• Grid-system knowledge

• Technical infographic design

• Excellent spacing and alignment discipline

• Technical-document design

• B2B product presentation

• Brand-system thinking

• Professional image editing

• Video editing

• Storyboarding

• Motion graphics

• AI-assisted creative workflows

• High attention to detail

• File and asset organisation

• Version-control discipline

• Ability to understand detailed instructions

• Ability to independently improve weak concepts

Technical Understanding Matters

MIIGO products involve:

Sensors • Measurement accuracy • Calibration • Data loggers • Industrial communication protocols • Graphs • Engineering specifications • Software platforms • Industrial applications • Technical tables and terminology

An engineering qualification is not mandatory.

However, the person must have the curiosity and analytical ability to understand technical information before designing it.

At MIIGO:

A visually beautiful design containing technically incorrect information is unacceptable.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Ideally:

• 3–8+ years of relevant professional experience

• Strong B2B, corporate, industrial or technical-design portfolio

• Multi-page catalogue/documentation experience

• Professional video-editing capability

• Experience with AI creative tools

• Ability to operate independently

• Strong English comprehension

• Exceptional attention to detail

Experience in instrumentation, electronics, industrial products, engineering, pharmaceutical, healthcare, SaaS, manufacturing or B2B technology will be an advantage.

Portfolio Is Mandatory

Your portfolio should preferably demonstrate several of the following:

• Multi-page catalogue/brochure

• Technical/corporate document

• Product advertising

• Social-media campaign

• Product-image editing

• Infographics

• Short promotional video

• Long-form/explainer video

• Motion graphics

• AI-assisted creative work

Applications without a relevant portfolio may not be shortlisted.

Who Should Consider This Opportunity?

This may be suitable for a senior creative professional who wants to move beyond executing assignments and participate in building a business vertical with long-term ownership, responsibility and profit participation.

You should be comfortable with:

\*\*Shared Responsibility

• Business Development Mindset

• Quality Ownership

• Long-Term Commitment

• Profit Sharing\*\*

This is not a conventional employee–employer opportunity.

MIIGO's Creative Quality Standard

We evaluate creative output on five dimensions:

\*\*Technical Accuracy

• Information Clarity

• Brand Consistency

• Visual Quality

• Commercial Effectiveness\*\*

If you believe you can help us build a world-class Visual Communication & AI Creative function under the upcoming MIIGO Digital Marketing Division, we would like to hear from you.

To receive the detailed partnership/business plan:

Share your CV + Portfolio via WhatsApp:

+91 93986 93085

MIIGO ONLINE LLP

title: Manager -  ECommerce
description: OverviewWe’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher to lead and evolve our user research practice within the digital commerce landscape. This role will serve as a key strategic partner to product and business leaders, driving the development of user-centered insights across the full interaction portfolio. The role focuses primarily on the EU market, aligning and executing research activities that directly shape our roadmap, improve user experience, and deliver commercial value.You will champion best-in-class research practices and leverage your deep experience in eCommerce and UX to support key product decisions across the organization.ResponsibilitiesOwn the end-to-end UX research process: From framing research questions to delivering actionable insights that drive decision-making at the leadership level. Plan and lead complex UX and A/B testing, coordinating with external vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with market goals and timelines. Translate commercial briefs into robust research hypotheses, with clear testing strategies and outcome measures. Produce strategic and tactical research deliverables, synthesizing findings into compelling narratives and best practice recommendations. Act as a voice of the consumer, ensuring that user needs and behaviors are deeply embedded in product planning and prioritization. Lead research governance by contributing to monthly roadmap planning, prioritization sessions, and sprint ceremonies. Help build and maintain a central research knowledge base, codifying insights, methods, and frameworks for repeatable success. Mentor junior researchers, and contribute to growing a culture of user-centered design and evidence-based thinking across the businessQualifications5+ years of UX research experience with a strong foundation in eCommerce or digital commerce environments. Deep knowledge of UX research methodologies including qualitative and quantitative approaches, usability testing, A/B testing, survey design, ethnographic studies, and journey mapping. Demonstrated ability to work at both strategic and executional levels, influencing product roadmaps and business priorities. Strong stakeholder management across large, cross-functional teams with varying priorities. Experience working in agile environments, managing competing priorities, and adjusting to fast-moving roadmaps. Excellent analytical and communication skills with a data-informed mindset and ability to distill complexity into clarity. Background in working with external research vendors and tools (e.g. User Zoom, User Testing, Dragonfly AI). Familiarity with UX and design tooling (Figma, Miro, Dovetail, Confluence, etc.) and how they integrate into broader product workflows.

title: Pre-Sales Executive - Designer
description:
**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales / Furniture Sales**

**Location:**
Alankaram Showroom, Hyderabad

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an
**Interior Designer with strong client-facing skills**
to join the Pre-Sales team at our Hyderabad showroom.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys understanding spaces, interacting with clients, recommending furniture and material solutions, and converting design conversations into successful orders.

Unlike a conventional retail-sales role, this position requires a strong understanding of
**interior design, furniture proportions, materials, finishes, space planning and aesthetics**
. You will work closely with homeowners, architects and interior designers to help them select and customise furniture suited to their spaces.

The role offers an opportunity to combine
**design knowledge with commercial and client-management skills**
, with a clear career path towards
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend to clients visiting the Bengaluru showroom and understand their requirements, lifestyle, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend appropriate furniture, materials, finishes, fabrics, colours and configurations.
* Help clients visualise how furniture will work within their interiors in terms of
  **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language**
  .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
  **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility**
  .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.

What We Are Looking For

**Education**

Bachelor's / Diploma in:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.

**Experience**

Ideally
**3–7 years of experience**
in one or more of the following:

* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials

Previous sales experience is useful but
**not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client-facing ability and commercial orientation**
.

Essential Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of
  **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences

Particularly Important for This Role

We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:

**“What kind of home are you creating?”**

to

**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”**

and eventually to:

**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”**

The candidate therefore needs to be
**a designer first, but commercially minded**
.

Performance Indicators

* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation-to-order conversion %
* Follow-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business

Career Growth

A strong candidate should be able to progress through:

**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales**

→
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer**

→
**Assistant Sales Manager**

→
**Sales Manager / Showroom Manager**

→
**Zonal Sales Manager**

→
**Regional Sales Manager**

**You should have:**

* Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
* 3+ years relevant experience
* Strong design and aesthetic understanding
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confidence dealing with premium clients
* Ability to understand drawings and space plans
* Strong ownership and follow-up skills
* A commercial mindset and willingness to work towards sales goals

**Why join Alankaram?**

Build expertise in premium furniture and client advisory while developing a career beyond conventional interior-design roles.

Strong performers can grow into
**Senior Pre-Sales, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager roles**
.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role:**
Full-time, showroom-based

title: Associate Course Designer
description:
**Job Title:**
Associate Course Designer (L10)
  
  
**Job Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Work Timings:**
1:00 PM to 10:00 PM (Monday – Friday)
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Associate Course Designer**
will have expertise in designing, storyboarding, and development of eLearning courses, micro-learning content, and video simulations. The ideal candidate will create focused, performance support How-To content for specific workflows for internal and external customers. They will apply relevant instructional design models and theories to develop rapid learning courses, videos, and infographics, using responsive design for modern learners.
  
  
**Eligibility & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline (preferably in English Literature, Journalism, Mass Communication, or Education)
* 1 to 3 years of experience in instructional design, technical writing, video simulations and infographics for software products and hardware
* Strong communication and writing skills
* Working knowledge in eLearning development tools (Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate preferred, MURF AI or experience in other speech to text tools)
* Experience with video editing tools (Camtasia, SnagIt or similar)
* Knowledge of graphic design tools like Photoshop and Illustrator (preferred)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Management: Work on multiple projects while ensuring adherence to timelines.
* Needs Analysis: Collaborate with Learning Program Managers (LPMs) and Subject Matter Expert (SMEs), and product teams to gather inputs.
* Design and Storyboarding: Create high-level design outline and storyboards for interactive/non-interactive course content.
* Content Development: Design and develop interactive eLearning modules, micro-learning videos, and infographics.
* In-App Guidance: Create and maintain user onboarding experiences, guided walkthroughs, and contextual help content using digital adoption platforms such as Amplitude and WalkMe.
* Review & Ensure Quality: Work with LPMs and SMEs for content validation and feedback implementation, ensuring the final outputs meet the defined standards.
* Continuous Learning: Build product, process, and business knowledge to further enhance the quality of deliverables as well as to stay up to date on the industry trends.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in working with SMEs, performing needs analysis, content gathering and shifting, instructional design processes, and storyboarding.
* Knowledge of applied pedagogy in instructional design technology.
* Understanding of content and learning management systems
* Basic knowledge of eLearning development tools.
* Ability to follow and apply defined content standards and styles.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to adapt to new technologies.
* Exposure to digital adoption platforms (WalkMe, Amplitude, Whatfix, Pendo) preferred.

title: Senior Consultant- Functional
description:
**Job Description**
MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
**Senior Consultant**
in a
**Functional Role.**
We are looking for a highly motivated individual with extensive experience in leading large-scale complex projects. The ideal candidate will be able to work closely with clients, understand their business processes, requirements, pain points, and objectives to effectively execute projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
The Senior Consultant is expected to lead large scale/complex project(s) executing the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Project Management:
* Collaborate with stakeholders to outline project goals and develop a detailed roadmap, incorporating early design validations.
* Requirements Analysis:
* Lead dynamic workshops and interviews to gather precise technical and functional requirements.
* Apply user-centric design methodologies, such as empathy maps, persona creation, and user journey mapping, to deeply understand user interactions and needs.
* Produce detailed user stories and process flows to communicate requirements effectively to technical teams and stakeholders.
* Develop interactive prototypes and high-fidelity mockups for iterative feedback and solution refinement.
* Formulate and test cases from design documents to cover all functionalities and conduct usability tests to confirm solution efficacy and user satisfaction.
* Facilitate stakeholder reviews of test cases to secure early approval, setting a strong foundation for UAT scripts.
* Solution Design
* Proficiently designing an architecture and functionality to meet business requirements with a focus on user centric design.
* Solution Configuration and Development:
* Lead configuration and customization of the Salesforce platform based on the requirements to provide an optimal user experience.
* Lead the data migration process from legacy systems to Salesforce, collaborating closely with project teams and data analysts to ensure a smooth transition.
* Testing and Quality Assurance:
* Validate functionalities against business requirements through test scenario execution.
* Conduct thorough post-migration audits to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Work with business users to identify any issues and coordinate with technical teams to rectify discrepancies.
* Conducting and leading unit, integration, and end-to-end testing to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to business requirements.
* Execute UAT with stakeholders to ensure the solution meets final expectations and system specifications.
* Deployment, Transition, and Documentation:
* Responsible for functional configuration deployment and data migration.
* Create documentation on requirement gathering, business process (creating process diagram, flowcharts, process narratives etc,) using tools.
* Lead adoption through customized training programs, supporting post Go-Live plans for enhanced utilization of new processes and technology.
* Post-Implementation Review and Iterative Improvement:
* Provide ongoing support after deployment, addressing system issues and optimizing performance.
* Continuously collect user feedback to evaluate solution impact and identify improvement areas.
* Organization Development:
* Mentorship and Guidance:

+ Provide mentorship and guidance to the project, fostering their professional growth and development within the team.

* Growth and Development of Project/ Regional teams:

+ Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in the field.
+ Lead continuous improvement of Salesforce development processes and procedures.
+ Participate in the hiring process to identify top talent for the projects in the region per the need.
+ Support the HR team in performance documentation of project team members.

* Contribution to the COE (Center of Excellence)

+ Contribute to the development of COE with relevant deliverables and assets.

* Operational Excellence:

+ Maintenance of Salesforce Certifications.
+ Required to travel for key project milestones.
+ Maintain utilization goals.

**What you will bring:**

* 6+ years of experience in a functional role within the IT consulting industry, with strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce.
* Proficient in designing and implementing functional solutions, workflows, and : processes that meet client requirements and objectives.
* Proficient in facilitating working sessions with key stakeholders and subject matter experts via workshops, interviews, and business process review sessions.
* Proficient in creating documentation on requirement gathering, business process (creating process diagram, flowcharts, process narratives etc,) using tools.
* Proficient in data management concepts and best practices for importing, exporting, and managing data.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics is a plus, particularly in functional consulting, solution design, business process mapping, or implementation.
* Experience in designing and executing comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate Salesforce solutions is a plus.
* Strong communication, interpersonal skills with a user centric approach to problem solving.
* Bachelor's degree and above is desirable.

**What we offer:**

* Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan - Self + Spouse + 4 Dependent Children)

+ Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/-
+ Maternity cover upto two children
+ Cashless & Reimbursement facility
+ Access to free online doctor consultation

* Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) -

+ Sum Insured: INR. 25,00,000/- Per Employee
+ Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
+ Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
+ Temporary Total Disability is covered

* Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. 8800 per month)

+ Offered as a tax saver component
+ Part of the special allowance component in the CTC

* Monthly Internet Reimbursement of upto Rs. 1,000

title: Designer (Social Media & Marketing), 318 Digital
description:

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company: Grarri

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 1-2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site

About the Job

At Grarri, we specialize in merging exceptional design with strategic marketing to build, grow, and sustain powerful brands. Our mission is to create compelling digital experiences that connect with audiences and strengthen brand presence. We believe in creative innovation, thoughtful design, and delivering impactful results.

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with 1-2 years of hands-on experience in graphic design, video editing, and digital content creation. The ideal candidate should be proficient in Canva, Adobe video editing tools, and Figma, with a strong understanding of visual storytelling and the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance creative workflows.

Role and Responsibilities

1. Create engaging social media creatives, marketing collaterals, campaign visuals, and digital assets.

2. Develop creative concepts that align with brand identities and marketing objectives.

3. Edit videos and create engaging short-form content, including reels and promotional videos.

4. Use Canva, Adobe tools, and Figma to develop high-quality visual content.

5. Leverage AI-powered tools to explore creative ideas, improve workflows, and support content production.

6. Maintain consistency in typography, layouts, colours, and brand guidelines across platforms.

7. Collaborate with the marketing team to execute creative campaigns and meet project deadlines.

8. Stay updated on emerging design trends, video editing techniques, and AI-powered creative tools.

Qualifications and Skills

2. Proficiency in Canva, Adobe video editing tools, and Figma.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment:**
Full Time | In Office

**Experience:**
2–5 years preferred

**Department:**
Creative & Content

**ABOUT ZERO PROTOCOL**

At Zero Protocol, we show the world how rebels think.

We bring together entrepreneurs, creators, leaders, thinkers, and extraordinary individuals to explore ideas, experiences, and lessons that deserve to reach millions.

But, having a great conversation is only half the job.

The other half is making people curious enough to discover it.

That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a graphic designer who understands why people stop scrolling, what makes them click, and how a single image can make someone curious enough to watch a two-hour conversation.

Your work will influence how people discover, experience, and remember Zero Protocol.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

**YouTube Thumbnails & Content Packaging**

You’ll be responsible for designing thumbnails for our long-form podcast episodes, clips, and other YouTube content.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing multiple thumbnail concepts for every episode.

• Turning complex conversations into simple, compelling visual stories.

• Identifying strong emotional expressions, moments, and visual narratives from episode footage.

• Creating thumbnails that communicate curiosity, conflict, surprise, authority, or transformation.

• Experimenting with typography, composition, contrast, colours, and visual hierarchy.

• Working closely with researchers, editors, and content strategists to identify the strongest hooks from each conversation.

• Developing alternative thumbnail designs for testing.

• Analysing click-through rates and performance to understand what works and what doesn’t.

• Maintaining a recognisable visual identity while ensuring every episode has its own personality.

The goal is simple. Someone should understand why an episode is worth watching before they even read its title.

**Instagram & Short-Form Content Design**

You’ll also be responsible for how our content looks across social media.

This includes:

• Designing covers for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social clips.

• Developing a consistent and recognisable visual language for our short-form content.

• Creating typography-led designs that communicate ideas clearly.

• Designing carousels that turn complex insights into simple, useful, and shareable content.

• Creating quote graphics, episode announcements, guest reveals, and promotional creatives.

• Designing Instagram Stories, countdowns, and launch announcements.

• Adapting designs for different platforms, formats, and screen sizes.

• Collaborating with video editors to ensure the visual packaging accurately represents the content.

We want people to recognise our content even when our logo isn’t visible.

**Brand Identity & Visual Systems**

We’re not just producing podcast episodes. We’re building a media brand. You’ll play an important role in shaping and maintaining its visual identity.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and improving our overall brand identity.

• Developing typography systems, colour hierarchies, layouts, and reusable design templates.

• Creating consistent design principles across YouTube, Instagram, websites, and other digital platforms.

• Designing creative assets for campaigns, collaborations, merchandise, and special projects.

• Developing episode-specific visual identities wherever required.

• Organising and maintaining design files, templates, and brand assets.

• Ensuring that everything we publish meets our creative and quality standards.

The idea is to build a visual identity that remains recognisable as the brand grows.

**Creative Research & Concept Development**

We don’t want someone who waits for a brief, finishes the design, and moves on. We want the one who thinks about the work even before the brief arrives.

You’ll be expected to:

• Study some of the best-performing YouTube thumbnails and digital media brands in the world.

• Research visual trends across YouTube, Instagram, entertainment, and digital publishing.

• Understand how creators use facial expressions, framing, colour, typography, and curiosity to attract attention.

• Develop mood boards and visual references before major releases.

• Bring original creative ideas to brainstorming sessions.

• Question existing design approaches and suggest improvements.

• Build a reference library of successful designs, experiments, and creative concepts.

We want someone who can bring fresh ideas to the table rather than simply reproduce what’s already popular.

**THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED**

**Technical & Design Skills**

You should be proficient in:

• Adobe Photoshop, including advanced image manipulation, compositing, masking, retouching, and colour correction.

• Adobe Illustrator for vector graphics, typography, and visual assets.

• Figma for layouts, design systems, and collaboration.

• Typography, including font selection, pairing, hierarchy, spacing, and readability.

• Colour theory, contrast, composition, and visual balance.

• Photo manipulation and creative visual storytelling.

• Designing for mobile-first viewing experiences.

• Preparing high-quality assets across different aspect ratios and resolutions.

Experience with After Effects, Blender, Cinema 4D, or other 3D and motion design tools would be an added advantage.

**Creative Thinking**

You should have a strong understanding of:

• Why some thumbnails get clicked while others are ignored.

• How to create curiosity without misleading the audience.

• How facial expressions communicate emotions.

• How to simplify complicated ideas into one powerful visual.

• How typography influences the way a message is perceived.

• How visual hierarchy directs attention.

• How to create premium-looking designs without unnecessary complexity.

• How to balance creative originality with content performance.

We care about your ability to explain why a design works, not just whether it looks good.

**Understanding of Content & Platforms**

You should be familiar with:

• YouTube and the creator ecosystem.

• Long-form podcasts and interview formats.

• Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

• Digital storytelling and audience psychology.

• Content packaging and creative experimentation.

• Basic performance metrics such as impressions, click-through rates, reach, and engagement.

You don’t need to be a marketing expert.

But you should understand that good design has a purpose beyond aesthetics.

**HOW WE’LL MEASURE YOUR WORK**

We care about both the quality of your designs and the impact they create.

**Thumbnail Performance**

Are our thumbnails improving in terms of click-through rates, taking into account the audience, topic, title, and traffic sources?

**Creative Experimentation**

Are you consistently exploring meaningful alternatives instead of relying on the same design formula?

**Brand Recognition**

Are we developing a visual identity that people can recognise across platforms?

**Social Media Packaging**

Are our covers helping people understand, discover, and recognise our content?

**Quality & Execution**

Are you delivering thoughtful, high-quality work within agreed timelines?

**Collaboration**

Are you communicating effectively with researchers, editors, producers, and content strategists?

**Originality**

Are you bringing new ideas to the team rather than repeating existing templates?

**Creative Growth**

Are you learning from feedback, audience behaviour, and performance data?

We don’t expect every design to go viral. We expect you to learn, experiment, and improve consistently.

**These aren’t mandatory, but we’d love to hear about them if you have experience in:**

• Motion graphics and animation.

• AI-assisted image generation and editing.

• Photography and portrait retouching.

• YouTube thumbnail experimentation.

• Entertainment, documentary, or editorial design.

• Art direction for photography and video shoots.

• Website and landing-page design.

• Merchandise and physical brand applications.

• Designing for multilingual audiences.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US**

• An opportunity to design content for a large and highly engaged digital audience.

• Creative ownership over meaningful, high-visibility projects.

• Exposure to extraordinary guests, ideas, and conversations.

• The freedom to experiment, learn, and improve your craft.

• An opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a growing media brand.

• Competitive compensation based on your experience, portfolio, and demonstrated capabilities.

**HOW TO APPLY**

We’d like to understand how you think, not just what software you know.

Please share the following:

**1. Your Portfolio**

Send us five to ten of your strongest designs.

We’re particularly interested in YouTube thumbnails, social media creatives, and brand identity projects.

**2. Your Best Thumbnail**

Share one thumbnail you’re especially proud of.

Tell us what the idea was, why you made the design decisions you did, and what you believe makes it effective.

**3. A Creative Breakdown**

Choose any YouTube thumbnail you admire.

Explain what makes it work. We’d love to understand how you think about attention, curiosity, composition, and storytelling.

**4. Your Resume**

Include your relevant work experience, software proficiency, current location, and availability.

**5. Compensation Expectations**

Let us know your expected compensation and, if you’re comfortable sharing it, your current compensation.

**Send your application to:**
tanieyakumari@zeroprotocol.in

**Email Subject:**
Graphic Designer Application | Zero Protocol

**ONE LAST THING**

We’re looking for someone who can understand a conversation, find the most interesting idea within it, and turn that idea into something people want to click on. Someone who understands that design isn’t just about how something looks.

It’s about what it makes people feel, think, and do.

If you believe a single image can make someone curious enough to spend two hours listening to a conversation, we’d love to see your work.

Bachelor's degree
