title: Digital Solution Designer
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Divami**

Divami is a design partner to product companies working on hard, high-stakes problems in AI-first platforms, enterprise SaaS, financial products, and category-defining tools. Our clients do not come to us because their designs need polish. They come to us because their product needs to become a decision engine rather than a well-styled interface, and we turn strategy into shipped work with the frameworks to make it repeatable.

**The role**

You would own the design solution across a client engagement end-to-end. That work starts before the brief, in the effort of framing what the actual problem is. It runs through information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, and the invisible logic tying them together. And it continues past the handover into the health of the client relationship itself. You would be the person clients trust to sharpen their thinking rather than just deliver against it, and you would produce frameworks other people at Divami reuse without rework.

**What you’ll own**

* **Client success, not just deliverables.**
  You measure your work by renewal, expansion, and satisfaction rather than by whether the file was handed off on time. Accounts grow because of your ownership.
* **The problem before the solution.**
  You proactively close gaps in user or business understanding before anyone flags them. If something is fuzzy, you name it and go after it, rather than waiting for the brief to catch up.
* **The whole solution, not just the screens.**
  Information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, empty states, and the invisible logic tying them together.
* **Direction, not just execution.**
  You shape client or product direction through design thinking and innovation judgment. When the situation calls for it, you push for disruptive or category-defining solutions rather than defending against safe defaults.
* **Design rationale others can rely on.**
  You document trade-offs, decisions, and the reasoning behind them so the next person on the account is not starting from zero.
* **Reusable IP.**
  You produce frameworks, patterns, and playbooks that other designers at Divami pick up and use as they are. Your work compounds beyond your own engagements.
* **The room.**
  You handle direct client pushback with reasoning rather than defensiveness. You walk into leadership presentations without a safety net and walk out with alignment.
* **The bench.**
  You coach other designers in business-first thinking, disruptive versus incremental framing, and client handling. Designers around you level up because you are on the account.

**How you’ll think**

* **Problems get sharpened before they get solved.**
  You find the 20 percent that drives 80 percent of the value, and you name it clearly enough that everyone on the account can see the same problem.
* **Outcomes are visible at the moment of decision.**
  Every screen should tell the user and the business what happens next, and why. If the outcome is invisible, the design is not done.
* **Reasoning is portable.**
  Trade-offs get documented, decisions get explained, and the thinking behind a call is captured so the next person picks up where you left off.
* **Disruptive or incremental is a choice, not a default.**
  You know when to push for the category-defining answer and when the safe one is genuinely the right call. You can defend both.
* **Client success is a design metric.**
  Renewal, expansion, and satisfaction sit inside how you measure your own work, not outside it.
* **Multiplication over addition.**
  Your best work compounds through the frameworks others use, not through the individual files you personally shipped.

**The craft**

* **UX and product design mastery.**
  Information architecture, interaction patterns, decision flows, edge cases, and design systems. Craft you can defend on principle rather than just on intuition.
* **Business fluency.**
  Reading the shape of a business, sizing an opportunity, and sizing the risk of a design choice. You can talk to a CXO in their language, not just yours.
* **Facilitation.**
  Workshops, alignment sessions, and co-creation with clients. You can hold a room when the room disagrees.
* **Executive presence.**
  Walking a leadership team through a hard call without breaking rapport, and reframing the conversation when the reasoning holds up.
* **Framework thinking.**
  Turning specific learnings from one engagement into reusable IP that helps the whole practice get better.
* **Written and visual communication that lands.**
  Strategy docs, decision memos, walkthroughs, and slides that carry an argument on their own.

**Signals we look for**

These are patterns we watch for in how you talk about past work rather than items to tick off a checklist.

* **You describe a project by its client outcome.**
  The deliverable list is the least interesting part of the story you tell.
* **You can point to a moment you disagreed with a client.**
  You held the line with reasoning, and it changed the direction of the work.
* **You have produced something others still use.**
  A framework, a playbook, a decision pattern, or a system that other designers pick up without rework.
* **When you describe ambiguity, you describe how you closed it,**
  not how you flagged it.
* **You have a view on when to build the incremental thing**
  and when to push for the disruptive one. You can defend both calls.
* **You measure your work by what happened after it shipped,**
  not by how it looked at handoff.

**Qualifications**

* **6 to 8 years**
  designing digital products across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, or platforms with real complexity. Meaningful time in senior IC or lead roles.
* **A portfolio of decisions, not just artifacts.**
  Case studies that show how you moved from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and where you traded off.
* **Evidence of account ownership.**
  Concrete examples of relationships you grew, renewed, or expanded because of how you showed up, not just because of what you shipped.
* **Executive-room confidence.**
  You can present to a CXO, hear a hard pushback, and respond with reasoning that reframes the conversation without getting defensive.

**Why this role**

* **Ownership that is real.**
  You own the account, the outcome, and the direction, not just a Figma file.
* **A new domain every quarter.**
  AI-first platforms, enterprise tools, financial products, and industry-defining software. Range that compresses years of learning.
* **Frameworks that are actually used.**
  Divami’s methodology (VEDA), empathy-led frameworks, and outcome-driven approaches we have validated across real client work.
* **Room to shape how we work,**
  not just what we ship. If you have opinions about how design should be practiced, we want them on the table.
* **A bench of people**
  who take craft and business seriously in equal measure.

**About The Role**
Qonfido is building an AI companion for money, helping people organise, understand, and grow their wealth with clarity and confidence.
  
  
As a Founder's Office Intern, you will sit at the centre of the company: close to strategy, product, data, and day-to-day execution. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams, present recommendations to founders, and help turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into shipped outcomes.
  
  
You will move across strategy setting, data analysis, product management support, AI optimisation, and operational follow-through, learning how a modern fintech startup actually runs.
  
  
If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.
* Help write PRDs, specs, acceptance criteria, and release checklists for priority initiatives.
* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.
* Design and document prompts, agents, and SOPs for research, writing, analysis, QA, and reporting.
* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.
* Available full-time (or near full-time) for 3–6 months; based anywhere in India (IST or a similar timezone).

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.
* Personal projects, campus clubs, or research where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.
* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.
* Fintech, consumer apps, or personal-finance curiosity.
* Design fluency (Figma/Canva) or light engineering fluency.

Why join us
  
  
You will work directly with founders at an early-stage fintech building AI-native money products: rare exposure for an internship.

In this role, you will serve as the creative strategist for new business pursuits supporting Deloitte’s businesses. You will work closely with senior leaders, pursuit strategists, writers, and cross-functional teams to shape the visual narrative of pursuit materials, elevate design quality, and bring clarity to complex information through strong conceptual thinking and refined execution.
  
  
This is not a people-management role. Instead, it is a senior individual contributor role for a creative professional who sets direction through expertise, influence, innovation, and exceptional design craft. You will also help advance the team’s capabilities by exploring emerging tools, technologies, and GenAI-enabled design approaches.

* Maintain high standards of craft, consistency, and attention to detail while managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, pursuit-driven environment.

**Details**

* **Openings: 2**

**About TRINANCE ?**

TRINANCE is a financial education platform making finance more accessible, practical, and engaging. Our newsletter is the core of what we do we simplify investing and personal finance for a growing readership. Around it, we're building a mobile app and web experiences that help people learn, explore, and make better financial decisions.

We're early-stage, which means the products you work on are real, live, and still being shaped.

**The role**

You'll work primarily on the TRINANCE mobile app — designing and improving experiences across the product — with opportunities to contribute to our website and internal tools.

You'll work directly with our Senior Product Designer, the founders, and our developers. This is a role for someone who wants to learn the full product design process, not just push pixels on UI screens.

This internship runs for 4–5 months and is designed as a path into a full-time Product Designer role at TRINANCE for interns who do strong work.

**What you'll do**

* Design flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI for the TRINANCE app
* Contribute to website and internal dashboard design
* Turn user problems into design solutions, and explain the reasoning behind them
* Build and maintain reusable components as part of our design system
* Work with developers to take designs from concept to shipped
* Iterate based on feedback, testing, and changing product requirements

**What we're looking for**

Prior professional experience isn't required. Students and freshers with a genuine interest in product design are encouraged to apply.

You'll do well here if you:

* Understand the fundamentals of UI/UX and product design
* Are comfortable in Figma
* Have a good eye for layout, typography, spacing, and hierarchy
* Understand user flows and basic interaction design
* Are curious about why products work the way they do
* Take feedback well and iterate quickly
* Communicate your design decisions clearly

You'll experience the complete design process, end to end:

Problem → Research → User Flows → Wireframes → UI → Prototype → Feedback → Iteration → Development

title: UI/UX Designer – Job Description
description:
**UI/UX Designer – Job Description**

At
**Lotus Digital**
, design is not decoration. It is architecture, psychology, and performance combined.

We design digital experiences for local businesses, service-based B2B companies, B2C brands, and global clients. That means our UI/UX work must be intuitive, scalable, conversion-focused, and adaptable across industries and audiences.

As a
**UI/UX Designer**
, you’ll be involved from problem definition to final execution. You’ll work closely with SEO specialists, developers, performance marketers, and strategists to design websites and digital products that are not only visually refined but also aligned with user intent, business goals, and data insights.

This role is ideal for designers who understand layout systems, user journeys, and design consistency, and who want to evolve in an AI-enabled, startup agency environment where experimentation and learning are encouraged.

**Location / Work Mode:**
India (Remote / Hybrid / Onsite – based on availability and collaboration needs)

**Key Responsibilities**

**UI Architecture & Design Systems**

* Design scalable UI structures for websites, landing pages, and digital platforms
* Create and maintain layout grids, spacing systems, and visual hierarchies
* Develop reusable design components to ensure consistency across projects
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate design implementation

**UX Research & User Behaviour**

* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows
* Design wireframes and prototypes that reduce friction and improve usability
* Apply UX best practices for both B2B (logic-driven journeys) and B2C (emotion-driven journeys)
* Continuously improve designs using feedback, analytics, and user behaviour data

**Conversion-Focused Design**

* Design landing pages and interfaces optimised for lead generation and engagement
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams to support CRO initiatives
* Understand how CTA placement, copy hierarchy, and visual structure impact conversions
* Iterate designs based on A/B testing insights and performance data

**Collaboration & Cross-Functional Work**

* Work closely with SEO teams to ensure search-friendly layouts and content placement
* Coordinate with WordPress and Laravel developers for feasible, scalable designs
* Participate in project discussions to align design with timelines and technical constraints
* Present design rationale clearly to internal teams and stakeholders

**AI-Assisted Creative Workflows**

* Use AI tools to support ideation, mood boards, layout exploration, and concept validation
* Apply AI responsibly to automate repetitive tasks while preserving human creativity
* Stay updated with emerging AI design tools and evolving UX trends
* Adapt design approaches as user expectations evolve with AI-driven experiences

**Preferred Qualifications & Experience**

**Design Experience**

* 2–3 years of hands-on UI/UX design experience in a digital agency or startup
* Strong portfolio showcasing websites, landing pages, or product design projects
* Experience working with B2B and B2C clients across industries
* Exposure to global clients or international design standards is a plus

**Tools & Technical Understanding**

* Proficiency in tools like Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar platforms
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and design systems
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles
* Ability to design with development feasibility in mind

**AI & Modern Design Mindset**

* Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted design or ideation tools
* Understanding of how AI influences user behaviour and interface expectations
* Willingness to continuously evolve design approaches in a fast-changing ecosystem

**Professional Traits**

* Strong execution mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a startup agency environment
* Clear communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Curiosity to test, learn, and refine design decisions

**Why Join Lotus Digital?**

* Design real products and platforms—not just static mockups
* Work on diverse B2B, B2C, and global projects
* Collaborate with experienced marketers, developers, and strategists
* Grow in a startup agency where design directly impacts business results
* Build a portfolio that reflects strategy-driven, conversion-focused design

title: Digital Products Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. title: Manager, Product Design: Application Observability
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
Your opportunity
  
  
New Relic is hiring an on-site design manager for our Hyderabad team, leading design for Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Log Management — two of the platform's most used products. APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale — ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.
  
  
This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present — in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made — is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.
  
  
You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters. If you've led a small design team on complex technical products and want clear ownership of both the work and the people — this is that role.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Manage and develop your designers — run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.
* Own design quality across APM and Logs — review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. You're accountable for what ships.
* Keep the user's perspective in the conversation — design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. You bring user needs and research insights into roadmap conversations, not just design reviews.
* Partner with PM and Engineering — work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms of outcomes the business tracks: adoption, retention, time to value.
* Keep the team focused and on track — manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.
* Help your team use AI well — stay curious about tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Gemini and how they can help your designers work better: faster exploration, smarter prototyping, better research synthesis. You don't need to be an expert, but you're not slowing down experimentation either.
* Contribute IC design work when the work calls for it — you're an experienced designer, and there are moments where the team needs your hands on a problem. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.
* Hire well — contribute to recruiting when the team has open roles. Use each hire to bring in diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and build the kind of team where different viewpoints make the work better.
* Connect Hyderabad to the rest of the design org — bridge your team to design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain. Apply New Relic's design standards and practices locally, and make sure your team isn't working in isolation from the broader design org direction.

This role requires
  
  

* 8+ years of product design experience, with meaningful time on technically complex B2B or enterprise software — products with data-dense interfaces, technical users, and real stakes in production
* 2–4 years of direct people management — you've run 1:1s, given honest performance feedback, and developed designers at different career stages
* Experience working across time zones — comfortable with async communication and able to build real working relationships with partners you won't always be in the same room as
* A clear design point of view and the confidence to use it — you can evaluate work, give specific feedback, and hold a position with a PM or engineering partner who pushes back
* Strong written and verbal communication in English — this is a distributed org and clear communication is how work stays connected across it
* A portfolio showing your design process and how you reason through hard problems — not just finished screens, but how you think and what tradeoffs you made

Bonus points if you have
  
  

* Experience with APM, log management, observability, or similar developer-facing infrastructure products
* Familiarity with design systems and when to work within them vs. when to push on them
* Experience hiring and growing a design team over time, not just managing a steady state
* Hands-on curiosity with AI tools — Figma AI, Claude, Gemini, and others — in your own workflow or helping your team adopt them
* Comfort prototyping with code or code-adjacent tools — Cursor, v0, Replit, or similar

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Media \& Advertising is a website development and digital marketing company based in Hyderabad, serving a diverse range of clients and industries. The team focuses on creating impactful online experiences that help businesses strengthen their brand presence and reach target audiences effectively. By combining technical expertise with creative strategy, V Media \& Advertising delivers solutions that are tailored to client goals and market demands. The company values collaboration, innovation, and design excellence, providing a dynamic environment for creative professionals.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 As a Senior Graphic Designer, you will be responsible for leading the visual design of digital and print materials, including websites, social media assets, marketing campaigns, and brand collateral. You will translate client requirements into clear, compelling visual concepts, create and refine design layouts, and ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints. Day\-to\-day activities include developing design concepts, collaborating with marketing and web development teams, preparing assets for production, and reviewing design work to maintain high quality standards. You will also mentor junior designers, contribute to creative strategy discussions, and participate in client presentations when needed. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with a portfolio demonstrating creative and professional work.
* Proficiency in Logo Design and Branding, including the ability to develop and maintain cohesive visual identity systems.
* Solid understanding of Typography and layout principles, ensuring clear, legible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
* Expertise in industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma or similar).
* Experience designing for web and digital platforms, including social media and online advertising campaigns.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work effectively with cross\-functional teams on\-site.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders and clients.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; prior experience in a senior design role is preferred.
* Video editing is preferable.
* Agency Experience is Must

 We need someone who can convert complex technical products, engineering information, and commercial concepts into visually outstanding, technically accurate, and commercially effective communication.
 



  





 This opportunity is not suitable for someone whose experience is limited primarily to routine Canva templates or basic social\-media posts.
 



  





 Workflow Mastery Required:
 



 Understand → Structure → Conceptualise → Design → Review → Correct → Validate → Deliver
 



  





 𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them.
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use.
 



 It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.
 



**What you will be doing** 




 •
 **Delivering from the backlog.** 
 Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.
 



 •
 **Building across the stack.** 
 Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.
 



 •
 **Working with structured and unstructured data.** 
 Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.
 



 •
 **Integrating with enterprise platforms.** 
 Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.
 



 •
 **Applying AI where it earns its place.** 
 Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.
 



 •
 **Proving the work.** 
 Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.
 



 •
 **Shaping what gets built.** 
 You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.
 



  





**Skills and experience** 




  





***Essential***




  





**Area** 




**What we are looking for** 




 Commercial experience:
 



 8\+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.
 



 Core languages:
 



 Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C\# as a secondary language is welcome.
 



 Back end:
 



 Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.
 



 Front end:
 



 React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client\-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.
 



 Data:
 



 Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.
 



 Data formats:
 



 Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.
 



 Cloud:
 



 Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.
 



 AI engineering:
 



 Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.
 



 Engineering practice:
 



 Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.
 



  





***Highly regarded***




 • Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform
 



 • Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce
 



 • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware
 



 • Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing
 



 • Reporting and analytics platforms
 



 • Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: Designer - Decor, Events, Product & Fashion
description:
**About Booncart:** 




 At Booncart., we believe every moment of celebration deserves to be unforgettable. From birthdays and weddings to corporate events and festivals, every occasion tells a story.
 



  





 We are event\-focused e\-commerce marketplace, curating a wide variety of décor, gifting, and celebration essentials. **Role Overview:** 




 The Creative Designer will be responsible for designing new products, developing prototypes, creating compelling content, and ensuring a strong brand presence across e\-commerce and social media. This is a hybrid role combining fashion design, product development, Visual storytelling, creative execution, and digital content creation.
 



  





 You will take ideas from scratch →research \-  design → budgeting → vendor coordination→field visits \-  prototyping → photoshoot → listing → social media content → final customer experience.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who is both creatively driven and execution\-focused.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




1. **Creative \& Design:**



  





 ·      Develop new products across fashion, event design concepts, and theme ideas for various celebrations \- birthdays, weddings, festivals, and corporate events.
 



  





 ·      Prepare mood boards, sketches, and style guides.
 



  





 ·      Design and conceptualize décor sets, gifting ideas, and small\-budget event products.

 ·      Design packaging materials, product tags, labels, and Booncart’s signature unboxing experience.
 



  





**2\. Production Execution \& Budgeting**




  





 ·      Estimate production costs and prepare basic budgets for samples and final products.
 



  





 ·      Identify cost\-effective materials, trims, and packaging solutions.
 



  





 ·      Work closely with local markets, suppliers, and vendors to source materials.
 



  





 ·      Track production timelines, sample iterations, and maintain quality control.
 



  





 ·      Maintain product documentation, inventory of samples, and design archives.
 



  





 ·      Ensure product quality, attention to detail, aesthetic consistency, and market relevance.
 



  





**3\. Photo \& Video Content Creation** 




  





 ·      Plan and execute high\-quality product shoots (photo and video).
 



  





 ·      Shoot prototypes and final products using an in\-house setup.
 



  





 ·       Capture styling shots, detail shots, flat lays, packaging visuals, and lifestyle mood content.
 



  





 ·      Edit images/videos for catalog, website, and social media.
 



  





 ·      Maintain a clean, consistent visual style aligned with Booncart’s brand.
 



  





**4\. Social Media Content Development** 




  





 ·      Plan and create content calendars aligned with product launches and campaigns.
 



  





 ·      Design engaging reels, posts, lookbooks, and story content.
 



  





 ·      Write captions, tag products, and apply trending formats where suitable.
 



  





 ·      Maintain daily posting consistency and brand tone.
 



  





 ·      Track platform insights and adapt content for growth and engagement.
 



  





**5\. Brand Building \& Misc. Creative Work** 




  





 ·      Support in designing festival collections, seasonal campaigns, and gifting ranges.
 



  





 ·      Create digital marketing assets—ads, posters, brochures, lookbooks.
 



  





 ·      Assist in POP displays, event stalls, booth design, or packaging setups.
 



  





 ·      Participate in brainstorming sessions for new ideas, collaborations, or vendor onboarding.
 



  





  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 ·      2–4 years of experience in fashion design, product design, or creative digital roles.
 



  





 ·      Strong understanding of Indian sourcing, fabrics, trims, and material markets.
 



  





 ·      Ability to handle end\-to\-end product development—from idea to prototype to shoot.
 



  





 ·      Proficiency in design tools: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Lightroom, Premier Pro, or similar.
 



  





 ·      Comfortable working on shoots, editing content, and preparing high\-quality visuals.
 



  





 ·      Strong grasp of social media trends, content pacing, and digital storytelling.
 



  





 ·      Knowledge of e\-commerce backend basics and listing systems(Is a PLUS).
 



  





 ·      Detail\-oriented, organised, and capable of managing multiple projects in a startup setup.
 



  





  





  





 ·      Job Type:

 ·      Competitive and based on experience, with performance\-based growth opportunities.

 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.

* Market Research:
+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.

* Player Insights:
+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.


**Must Have**
* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.


**What Success Will Look Like**
 During the internship, the intern should be able to:
   

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.


**Sample Internship Projects**
 Depending On The Team’s Priorities, The Intern Will Be Assigned To a Game Team, And They May Work On Projects Such As
   

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Content Designer
description:
Content Designer
 




  





**The Designer will support the design of high\-impact learning and leadership programs. The role focuses on research\-backed instructional structuring, learning asset creation, and quality assurance. Working closely with senior designers and business stakeholders, this role will contribute to building engaging, outcome\-driven learning experiences aligned with adult learning principles and business objectives.** 




**This position is execution\-focused with growing ownership at the Senior Analyst/Analyst level.** 




  





**Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Instructional Design \& Content Designing** 



* Apply the ADDIE framework (Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, Evaluate) in designing structured learning content for leadership and behavioral competency programs (e.g., performance management, strategic thinking, emotional intelligence, change leadership).
* Develop instructional storyboards, scripts, and content outlines for digital and blended learning programs.
* Contribute to e\-learning and microlearning development, including scenario\-based learning, assessments, and interactive elements.
* Collaborate with internal teams or vendors on digital module production and quality review.
* Ensure learning assets align with instructional goals, learner engagement, and program outcomes.
* Translate raw inputs, SME discussions, and client briefs into structured learning journeys, storyboards, facilitator guides, and participant materials.
* Design interactive learning tools including case studies, simulations, role\-plays, assessments, reflection exercises, and reinforcement assets.
* Apply adult learning principles and instructional design frameworks to ensure engagement and retention.
* Review and refine content for clarity, flow, tone, and alignment with learning objectives.








**2\. Learning Asset Management \& Quality Control** 



* Maintain structured repositories of learning materials and program assets.
* Track content revisions and ensure version control.
* Ensure consistency in templates, formatting, brand alignment, and instructional standards.
* Support evaluation of content effectiveness using participant feedback and engagement data.



**3\. Stakeholder \& Project Coordination** 



* Collaborate with instructional designers, facilitators, sales teams, and subject matter experts.
* Support preparation of presentation decks, concept notes, and sample modules for client discussions.
* Assist in tracking timelines, deliverables, and content milestones.
* Participate in internal reviews and design discussions.








**Qualifications:** 




**•         Senior Analyst: 1\-2 years of experience in instructional design, content development, learning research, or related roles.** 




**•         Bachelor’s degree in communications, English, Psychology, Education, Organizational Development, or related field.** 




**•         Strong writing, editing, and structuring skills.** 




**•         Sound understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design basics.** 




**•         Strong research and analytical capabilities.** 




**•         Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel); familiarity with e\-learning authoring tools is a plus.** 




**•         Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deliverables.** 




**•         Interest in leadership development, behavioural science, and learning innovation.** 




**Benefits:** 




**•         Exposure to Global Clientele** 
 – Opportunity to work with diverse clients across industries and geography, enhancing sales expertise and professional growth.
 



 •         
 **A Widespread Consulting Opportunity** 
 – Engage in impactful consulting projects, providing tailored L\&D solutions to clients and driving business success.
 



 •         
 **Collaborative Work Culture** 
 – Work alongside experts in a supportive and knowledge\-sharing environment that fosters innovation and success.
 



 •         
 **Competitive Leave Policy (Including Optional 1 WFH per Month)** 
 – Maintain work\-life balance with a flexible leave structure and occasional remote work options.
 



 •         
 **Business Hour Work Schedules** 
 – Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes efficiency and ensures a balance between professional and personal life.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
**Senior Visual Designer** 




*Location: (On\-site) Hyderabad, India* 




 Deccan AI is a Bay Area\-based data infrastructure company. We help frontier labs and enterprises with model training, fine\-tuning, and reliable AI deployment.
 



 We've raised a $25M Series A, and our customers include Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Snowflake, and several of the world's leading frontier labs and enterprises.
 



  





**The role:** 




 We're looking for a Senior Visual Designer to own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, pitch/sales decks, event collaterals, social media and more.
 



  





 This isn't a product design role.
 



  





 Our work is technically dense (ICP includes researchers, applied AI engineers and enterprise business transformation leaders). We’re looking for someone who enjoys turning technically complex ideas into visuals that can engage and convert.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies
* Work in tandem with product and event marketing teams to design campaigns and collaterals.
* Own launch/brand videos from start to finish: storyboard, animations, editing, and the final cut
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Move fast across Figma, Illustrator, PowerPoint, or code\-based tools
* Brief and manage 1–2 freelancers who provide extra hands on smaller campaigns
* Deliver files and set up processes that let marketers edit on the go
* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks.
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations.
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies.
* Design launch and campaign visuals alongside product marketing
* Storyboard motion assets and art\-direct animations and illustrations.
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Treat AI as a core part of your workflow including ideation, concepting, and faster drafts
* Deliver files and set up processes that enable marketers in the team to edit on the go.



  





**You should apply if** 



* You have 3–5 years of experience in visual, brand, or graphic design.
* You've closely worked with product marketers or extended marketing teams, converting dense technical content pieces into easy to grasp visual architectures.
* You hold strong opinions about your designs, yet can take feedback, and come up with new options if necessary that are in\-line with the requirements.
* You've owned launch or brand videos before, from storyboard through to a finished edit.
* You can prioritize ruthlessly and switch between tasks fast without losing quality. You'll be moving between web, decks, campaigns, and video at any given point.
* You've run or contributed to a branding exercise before, helping finalize an illustration style, a visual language, or a design system.
* You're proficient in Figma, Illustrator, and Google Slides, and you can hand off files in a form that’s editable for dependent functions.
* You treat AI as a daily collaborator. It's already part of how you brainstorm, wireframe and polish.



  





**You'll be a great fit if you** 



* Obsess over details.
* Have worked closely with product marketing, event marketing and sales enablement teams before. Brownie points if you’ve worked with leading AI/SaaS companies.
* Have owned information design end to end (1\-pagers, pitch decks, social posts, email, etc.) and have a portfolio that clearly shows how you decided which piece of content or visual fits where.
* Have designed web/landing pages before and understand how visual hierarchy affects CRO.



  





**Why Deccan AI?** 



* **High ownership:** 
 You'll own how Deccan AI looks and communicates across web, decks, and campaigns.
* **Flat hierarchy:** 
 We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:** 
 We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things, and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward: You'll have real room to experiment with different AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.**

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
**Great motion design isn't about software. It's about knowing exactly what needs to happen in 3 seconds to make someone stop scrolling.** 





 we're building the next generation of brand content — where human creativity and AI tools aren't competing, they're collaborating. We work with brands across industries to tell stories that move, literally and figuratively. If you're the kind of designer who gets restless watching flat content when you know it could be animated, you'll fit right in.
 




  






 We're a high\-energy team that genuinely loves this work. Fast, ambitious, and always pushing what's possible. If that energises you, keep reading.
 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO** 




  






 You'll be at the heart of our creative output — producing motion content that earns attention and builds brands across every digital platform.
 




  





**—** 

 Create motion graphics that stop the scroll
 
*Digital campaigns, social media, ads, product videos — if it moves, it's yours.* 




**—** 

 Lead with 3D, support with 2D
 
*3D animation is your primary strength; 2D motion graphics round out your toolkit.* 




**—** 

 Use AI tools as a creative advantage
 
*Runway ML, Kling AI, Pika Labs, Luma AI and more — you're already using them, not just curious about them.* 




**—** 

 Storyboard before you animate
 
*You think in sequences and know that good animation starts long before the timeline.* 




**—** 

 Produce content built for each platform
 
*Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites — you know how format, length, and format behaviour differ across all of them.* 




**—** 

 Collaborate across the creative team
 
*Work with designers, content strategists, and brand leads to ensure motion serves the bigger picture.* 




**—** 

 Stay sharp on what's emerging
 
*AI video generation, new rendering techniques, animation trends — you follow this space obsessively.* 




  





**YOU'RE PROBABLY THE RIGHT PERSON IF** 




  






 Must have: Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator. AI tools: Runway ML, Kling AI, Pika Labs, Luma AI, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion. Preferred: Blender, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya, DaVinci Resolve, Unreal Engine (basic), Figma.
 




  





**—** 

 2–5 years of professional motion graphics and animation experience
 




**—** 

 A portfolio that demonstrates strong 2D and 3D animation work
 
*Quality over quantity — we'll know in the first 60 seconds.* 




**—** 

 Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted creative workflows
 
*This is mandatory, not preferred.* 




**—** 

 Experience in advertising, digital marketing, creative studios, or media

**—** 

 A degree in Animation, Multimedia, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or Fine Arts
 
*Relevant certifications are a bonus.*

title: Product Designer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**The Role** 
  

  

 As a Product Designer, you'll own the design of complex, data‑rich experiences that support decision‑making for administrators and improve clarity and usability across our platform.
   

  

 You'll work as a senior individual contributor within a cross‑functional product team: Design, Product, Engineering, bringing product design expertise to your product area. While Product Management owns roadmap direction and prioritisation, you will play a critical role in informing decisions through research, design exploration, and user‑centred evidence, translating complexity into intuitive, accessible solutions.
   

  

 This role sits within a newly established team focused on analytics, dashboards, and reporting, where you'll elevate usability, interaction design, and data visualisation quality across StarRez products.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead complex design initiatives from discovery through delivery, translating multi‑role, data‑heavy workflows into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
* Conduct and contribute to continuous discovery activities, including customer interviews, usability testing, and concept validation, surfacing insights that inform product decisions and reduce delivery risk.
* Partner with Product to support clear problem framing, hypotheses, and measures of success, using research, experimentation, and customer feedback to validate design decisions and iterate solutions.
* Work iteratively, shipping improvements in stages and refining designs based on real‑world usage, feedback, and observed outcomes.
* Elevate data visualisation quality across dashboards and reporting experiences, ensuring information is clear, meaningful, and usable for diverse audiences.
* Strengthen the broader product experience by contributing to our design system and embedding accessibility best practices (WCAG 2\.2 AA) in collaboration with Engineering.
* Support stakeholder alignment through clear communication of UX decisions, improving usability and consistency through hands‑on critique, shared UI/UX patterns, and informal mentorship.
* Actively leverage AI‑powered tools and workflows within the design practice to accelerate exploration, iteration, and problem‑solving.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience designing complex SaaS or B2B digital products.
* Strong experience designing data‑rich interfaces, including dashboards, reporting tools, or complex operational systems.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to measurable product or business impact through improved usability, efficiency, or user satisfaction.
* Strong systems thinking and experience working across interconnected workflows or multi\-role platforms.
* Proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, and high\-fidelity execution.
* Experience leading discovery efforts and synthesizing insights into actionable product decisions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure high\-quality implementation.
* A strong sense of shared ownership, you care about outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Ability to balance speed with rigor, making thoughtful decisions grounded in research, data, and sound judgment.


  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in scale\-ups or growth\-stage product environments.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, testing tools, and assistive technologies.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled workflows, automation, or design\-to\-development optimisation practices.


*Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!*
  

  

**Reasons to join our Team:** 
  

  

 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 If you are excited about building game\-changing products in a high\-impact, collaborative environment—StarRez India is the place for you.
   

  

*We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.* 
  

  

  

  

***Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:***
  

  

*StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.*

title: Principal Product Designer, Platform Design
description:
What You Will Be Doing
   

  

* Set design direction for core platform surfaces: navigation, data grids, forms, dashboards, configuration, and personalization experiences that run manufacturing floors, warehouses, and supply chains
* Define and evolve platform\-level patterns in close partnership with the LUX design system team, making the call on what becomes a system pattern versus a product\-specific solution
* Lead ambiguous, cross\-product initiatives end to end, from problem framing through shipped outcomes and post\-launch iteration
* Work directly with UX Platform engineers on component behavior, states, APIs, and accessibility so that what ships matches what was designed
* Drive LUX adoption across product teams, acting as the connective tissue between the design system and the product areas that depend on it
* Raise the quality bar across the team through critique, standards, and mentorship of senior designers
* Influence platform roadmap and prioritization decisions alongside Product Management and Engineering leadership, with the judgment to know which trade\-offs matter
* Shape how AI\-native patterns show up at the platform level: agentic workflows, adaptive interfaces, and experiences that anticipate intent rather than wait for input


 What You Will Likely Bring
   

  

* 8\+ years of product design experience in enterprise or B2B SaaS, with a portfolio that shows platform\-level thinking, not just well\-executed features
* Deep design systems experience: you have built, scaled, or governed a system used by multiple product teams, and you understand contribution models, governance, and the politics of adoption
* Mastery\-level interaction design across dense data, multi\-role workflows, and configuration\-heavy interfaces
* Expert Figma proficiency, including variables, tokens, library architecture, and branching workflows
* Fluency working with engineers in their language: component states, semantic tokens, accessibility requirements, framework constraints
* Sharp judgment on when to extend a pattern, when to adapt it, and when to say no
* Active AI fluency in your daily practice, from research synthesis to prototyping, with a quality bar that AI output alone does not meet
* The communication skills to hold a room of product and engineering leadership and change its mind

* Experience shipping or governing a multi\-framework design system (web components, React, Angular, or Blazor)
* Hands\-on work with design token pipelines, Storybook, or design\-to\-code automation

* Experience using agent\-assisted development tools to move from design to working prototypes

title: Product Designer
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.
   

  

 As a Product Designer, you will partner with Product Managers to turn user problems and desired outcomes into clear user journeys, testable experiences, and practical design direction. You will work closely with Product and Engineering from early problem framing through implementation, using rapid prototypes to clarify decisions, expose gaps, and improve the product experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, early\-career role for a designer who combines strong UX and product thinking with visual judgment and prototyping fluency. The role also owns the quality and continuity of clickable product demos and selected product storytelling.
   

  

**As our Product Designer, you will be required to:**
* Partner with Product Managers to frame user problems, clarify desired outcomes, challenge assumptions, and identify what needs to be learned before a solution is committed.
* Translate problems and outcomes into user journeys, task flows, interaction models, and testable experience concepts.
* Build rapid, AI\-assisted prototypes using Figma, Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable tools, selecting the lightest approach that can answer the question at hand.
* Explore and communicate multiple design approaches, gather feedback, and iterate quickly rather than treating the first proposed screen as the answer.
* Maintain and evolve the persistent clickable product demo so that priority workflows remain current, coherent, visually credible, and easy to present.
* Create and update demo scenarios for Sales and stakeholder conversations when the production product does not yet tell the intended product story clearly.
* Produce clear development reference and handoff material, including annotated flows, states, edge cases, interaction behavior, and required assets.
* Partner with Engineering during implementation to answer experience questions, review working builds, and resolve material gaps between intent and execution.
* Support product storytelling through product screenshots, workflow visuals, short demo recordings, and selected customer\-facing visuals that directly explain the product experience.


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a closely related role. Exceptional candidates with 1\-2 years of strong, relevant work may also be considered.
* A portfolio that shows how you moved from a user problem to journeys, alternatives, prototypes, decisions, and a usable product outcome, not only final visual screens.
* Strong UX and product thinking, including the ability to simplify complex workflows, recognize assumptions, and connect interaction choices to user and business outcomes.
* Prototyping fluency in Figma and comfort using Figma Make, Lovable, or comparable AI\-assisted tools to move quickly from concept to testable experience.
* Strong visual judgment and enough craft to create polished, credible prototypes and demos.
* Clear communication and the confidence to challenge, clarify, and improve Product Manager thinking while remaining collaborative and outcome focused.
* Comfort partnering with Engineering, producing development\-ready references, learning unfamiliar tools quickly, and adapting the level of fidelity to the stage of work.
